title: PIXL 8000 Sour Pineapple Mango Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Sour Pineapple Mango PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod combines tropical Pineapple with luscious Mango for a vibrant sweet-and-tart flavour profile. The balance between tangy and mellow fruit notes creates a sunny, exotic vape full of character. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid formulated for smooth satisfaction and a comfortable throat hit. Compatible with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, it connects to a 10ml refill reservoir that automatically tops up the pod as you vape—supporting up to 8000 puffs per kit. Mesh coil technology keeps each draw smooth and flavour-rich with a natural MTL inhale.
